tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently attended a technology conference where you met Mr. Smith, a prominent industry expert. You found his presentation helpful and informative. You want to thank Mr. Smith for his presentation and request additional information on a topic he discussed. Write an email to Mr. Smith.
bullets: Mention what you found useful about his presentation.
Request additional information about one of the topics he discussed.
Express your appreciation for his time and insights.
tasks.subject: Your Presentation
